DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Erythema Toxicum Neonatorum.

The normal blood work rules out a severe bacterial sepsis or meningitis, and the classic presentation of a maculopapular rash with pustules that spares the palms and soles in a 4-day-old is diagnostic for this common, benign condition. No further testing or treatment is required; I will simply monitor the baby to ensure the lesions resolve spontaneously.
